market_mood: Geopolitical tensions and earnings reports are creating volatility.

themes.title: Geopolitical Tensions in Middle East
themes.what_happened: Yemen's Houthis launched ballistic missiles towards Riyadh amid Iranian threats; Saudi-led forces intercepted them.
themes.why_it_matters: Rising tensions may impact global oil supply and market stability.

our_exposure.why: Higher oil prices could boost energy revenues.

themes.next: Monitor further developments in regional tensions.

themes.title: Nvidia's First Earnings Report Since Leadership Change

themes.why_it_matters: Investor sentiment towards Nvidia's management transition impacts tech sector valuations.

our_exposure.why: Tech sector sympathy move with Nvidia.

themes.next: Look at Nvidia's earnings call details and analyst reactions.

themes.title: Bitcoin Volatility

themes.why_it_matters: Cryptocurrency volatility can influence risk sentiment across equities.
